title: Windows servers (PowerShell)
description: Let the assistant check Windows servers with PowerShell (services, event logs, free disk space). Any other command asks you first. WinRM must be enabled on the server.
perPerson: Only you can see and use your servers. The password stays on the server.
driverMissing: Windows PowerShell support is not installed on this server yet; ask the owner to update.
name: Name
passwordKept: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
verifyTls: Check the server certificate (untick for a self-signed certificate)
removeBody: The assistant can no longer run PowerShell on this server. The server itself is not changed.
errRequired: Fill in the name, server and Windows user.
errName: Names use letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores (up to 64).
errLoad: Could not load your Windows servers.
